text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, the academy is holding a
meet-and-greet
event for fans.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I just love the way you run, Ayabe! You
look like
a shooting star the way you
break away from the
pack.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you run fills me with courage! I've
wanted
to tell you that for the longest
time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll continue to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
That goes for your trainer, too! It's
fantastic how
you coordinate together!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to seeing great
things from
you two!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the words of praise, Admire
Vega seems
to be stiffening up the
longer we're here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. The next person is coming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She brushes me off and prepares for the
coming
visitors.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
I watched your mother race, too! I hope
you live
up to her legacy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. I hope for your continued
support.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you win your next race! I'm
rooting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She responds the same as usual, but I
can see
she's gradually getting more
stressed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that evening, Admire Vega has
disappeared
somewhere. Out of
concern, I go search for her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be at it training by herself
again. I can't
help but wonder why she's
pushing so hard. Could
it be...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not really...
choice_data_list: 今日みたいなイベントは苦手？

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's not necessary.
choice_data_list: 嫌なら、数を減らすとか――

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Rather... I need to listen more to my
fans.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Their support... it isn't really meant for
me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's her... who should be receiving the
praise.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yet here I am... receiving what's hers.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I have to meet their
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's been my mission since I was born. It's
the only
thing I can do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's been my mission since I was born. It's
the only
thing I can do.
choice_data_list: 俺も、できる事を一緒に頑張るよ
私も、できる事を一緒に頑張るよ

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's...
choice_data_list: 俺も、できる事を一緒に頑張るよ
私も、できる事を一緒に頑張るよ

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to seeing great
things from
you two!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Meeting their expectations...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well... I'll try not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Like what?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: 君の走りは、勇気を与える
貴方の走りは、勇気を与える

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you run fills me with courage! I've
wanted
to tell you that for the longest
time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
